prompt: Create a high-resolution 2048x2048 four-view reference sheet for one D&D Mummy undead tabletop miniature. Same full-body figure and combat-ready pose in every panel. Ancient dried humanoid wrapped in aged ivory and tan linen bandages, dark brown exposed face, faint amber eyes, simple tarnished bronze collar and belt, both unarmed fists raised ready to strike. Simple clean design. Painted realistic miniature style. White background, no base, no text or labels. Four equal square panels: top left FRONT, top right BACK, bottom left LEFT SIDE, bottom right RIGHT SIDE. Orthographic views, complete figure with margins, same scale and pose across all four views.
